title: Kho đề Writing (đề gốc, Claude soạn)

writingPrompts.text: Some people believe that university education should be free for all students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
writingPrompts.notes: Viết ít nhất 250 từ trong 40 phút.

writingPrompts.text:
The table below shows the percentage of households in a city that recycled different materials in 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Material | 2010 | 2020
Paper | 45% | 72%
Glass | 30% | 58%
Plastic | 18% | 49%
Food waste | 5% | 37%
Electronics | 3% | 15%
writingPrompts.notes: Viết ít nhất 150 từ trong 20 phút. Có câu tổng quan (overview).

writingPrompts.text:
The figures below show the average number of hours per week that people in one country spent using the internet, by age group, from 2005 to 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Age group | 2005 | 2010 | 2015 | 2020 | 2025
16–24 | 8 | 15 | 24 | 31 | 34
25–44 | 6 | 11 | 18 | 25 | 28
45–64 | 3 | 6 | 10 | 16 | 20
65+ | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 12
writingPrompts.notes: Viết ít nhất 150 từ trong 20 phút. Có câu tổng quan (overview).
